## Read this first

A tag `v0.6.0` was created for most of this content on 2026-09-20, but its
release run failed at the TestPyPI install-verification step and was never
retried; by the time it was revisited, `main` had moved on nearly 30 commits.
Rather than resurrect a stale tag, everything ships together as `0.7.0`.
**`v0.6.0` was never published to PyPI and never will be.**

**The de-identification benchmark on i2b2/n2c2 still has not been run.** The
harness and adapter ship and are tested, but that corpus is released only under
a Data Use Agreement and was not available. Every de-identification number
published (F1 0.933 rule-only, 0.922 with NER) is on a **synthetic** corpus - a
regression gate, not evidence of real-world accuracy. The default `DeidEngine`
does **not** detect names or street addresses; enable the opt-in NER recognizer
for those.

Other limits: providers are tested against mocked SDKs and models in CI,
including the new Azure/Bedrock/Vertex providers below - none has been run
against a live account; the UMLS `map()` call is unverified against the live
service; the groundedness check is a word-overlap heuristic.

Two v1.0 gates are explicitly skipped for now (2026-09-22), not silently
dropped: an independent evaluation of the de-identification stack, and the
published i2b2/n2c2 benchmark above, both need a party outside this repository
and neither is available right now.

**Behaviour changes since 0.5.0 that can change your output** (each fixes a defect,
except the last, which is additive):
- The default terminology guardrail now returns a **warning** ("unverifiable") for
  a code its small bundled subset cannot confirm, where 0.5.0 returned a **block**
  ("does not exist"). A block now needs a backend that is authoritative for that
  system.
- `DATE_SHIFT` now redacts non-date identifiers beside dates; 0.5.0 raised an
  error on such a document.
- Run manifests now keep token-count settings such as `max_tokens` instead of
  `[REDACTED]`; credentials are still redacted.
- Config validation now reports unknown or missing step parameters and off-site
  components under a local-only policy up front.
- Fan-out and fan-in in the streaming executor now run instead of being refused
  with a `ConfigError`.

## What is new since 0.5.0

The `openbtk` command line (`list`, `validate`, `run`, `deid`, `replay`,
`doctor`), clinical QA (MedQA / MedMCQA formats) and groundedness evaluation
with eval manifests, guides and a full API reference, eight tutorial notebooks
executed in CI, an API freeze with a registry-key snapshot test, a documented
deprecation mechanism, an internal security review with its findings fixed, and
twelve previously-unbuilt P2 requirements from the v1.0 PRD gate: a
dose-plausibility guardrail, k-anonymity, an HL7v2 loader, cross-modal
note/event joins, fuzzy concept normalisation, a cross-encoder reranker, hybrid
BM25 retrieval, three cloud LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google
Vertex), model cards, summarisation metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore), and
checkpoint/resume for long pipeline runs. Six core dependencies; everything else
is an optional extra.

```bash
pip install "openbtk[text]"
openbtk doctor
```

Full detail: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/openbtk/openbtk-core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
Docs: <https://openbtk.org/openbtk-core/>.
